meta.title: geofare | Natural hazard and climate risk, clear enough to act on
meta.description: geofare helps municipalities, planners and asset owners make good decisions about flood risk, physical climate risk and other natural hazards.

hero.subline: We turn satellite data, GIS and hydraulic modelling into risk information you can act on. Flood risk is where we go deepest.

services.title: See what's there.
services.body: We use satellite observations, open geodata and your own records to build a clear picture of the ground as it is today.

services.title: Know what's coming.
services.body: We model how water, weather and climate can hit your area, at the level of detail the decision needs.

services.title: Decide what comes first.
services.body: We assess what is at stake and rank the measures that make a difference, so your budget goes where the risk is.

services.title: Make risk make sense.
services.body: A risk nobody understands is a risk nobody acts on. We build the maps, visuals, tools and warnings that reach the people who have to act.

mission.title: Safer communities start with risk people understand.
mission.body: geofare specialises in flood risk management, physical climate risk and other natural hazards. We use satellite data, GIS and hydraulic modelling to make risk information clear enough to act on.

founder.title: Founder-led. Hands-on.
founder.body: geofare was founded by Niklas [surname], a geologist. He thinks in landscapes, works in data, and measures his work by what people do with it. He is as much at home in satellite imagery, maps and flood models as in the room where the decision gets made.

about.quote: Too much good hazard science never reaches the people who have to decide. I started geofare to change that.

team.title: A team built around your project.
team.body: You get Niklas, not an account manager. He leads every project and brings in the right specialists from our network when a job needs more hands. You always know who is doing the work.

principles.title: Start small.
principles.body: A first answer early, then more detail where it pays off.

principles.title: Open by default.
principles.body: Open data and open tools wherever they do the job.

principles.title: Yours to keep.
principles.body: You get the data, the models and the tools, not only a PDF.

principles.title: No layers.
principles.body: You talk to the person doing the work.

sectors.title: Different sectors. Same question.
sectors.intro: A municipality, a grid operator and a bank have little in common, until the water rises. Then they all ask the same thing: what can hit us, and what do we do about it? Here is how we answer it for each of them.

contact.title: Have a decision coming up?
contact.body: Tell us what you need to know. We will tell you what it takes to find out.
